newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 12.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 12.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Two major deals were announced in the United States affecting News Corp. The second largest satellite television group Primestar announced News and MCI had agreed to sell their satellite assets into a new Primestar group in exchange for US$1.1 billion of non-voting shares and convertible notes in the Primestar group. Also, the children's cable TV and entertainment group, International Family Entertainment (IFE) Inc, founded by TV evangelist Pat Robertson, announced News would pay US$35 a share cash or US$1.9 billion for IFE.
Adsteam Marine, which raised A$160 million through the issue of 80 million shares at A$2 each, is due to list at 11.30 p.m.
Highlands Pacific, which riased A$190 million through the issue of 190 million shares at A$1.00 per share, is due to list at 11.00 a.m.
Rio Tinto shares rose in London amid talk of analyst upgrades on the back of recent strength in copper prices.

Santos Ltd said on Wednesday its Thoar-2 gas appraisal well in south-west Queensland had proved successful. Santos said in a statement the well in the Queensland sector of the Cooper/Eromanga Basins flowed gas at a rate of 7.3 million cubic feet per day, with 51 barrels of condensate per day over the interval 2,030 metres to 2,040 metres.
